title: Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases: Extension of the Resolution Deadline, General Clause
content:
This clause states the general conditions for extending the resolution deadline of a Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases case.

**1. Days added and who may receive an extension.**

> *Retired wording, no longer in force:* "An extension adds the plan's extension days to the current resolution deadline and is granted only to a borrower or confirmed successor whose declared intent is to sell or to retain the property and who is actively marketing the property or obtaining financing."

**2. Request on file.** An extension is granted only against an extension request on file for the case whose request status is received and whose supporting evidence is one of the plan's extension evidence types. The authority is the request as recorded by Cedarline, matched by its own reference.

**3. Timing of the request.** An extension is granted only when the extension request is received no later than the current resolution deadline. The deadline day itself still counts, with a grace period of 0 days. Cedarline asks requesters to submit at least the plan's extension lead days, counted in calendar days, ahead of the deadline. A request received on the deadline is still processed. A request received later is declined as received after the deadline.

**4. HUD approval.**

> *Retired wording, no longer in force:* "An extension is granted only after HUD's extension-approved step for that extension number is recorded on the case, per the plan's extension HUD approval setting; on a Summit loan Cedarline approves it directly."

**5. Number of extensions.**

> *Retired wording, no longer in force:* "No case receives more than the plan's maximum extensions, counted by the extensions granted on the case; a request beyond the limit is declined as extension limit reached, and a request whose evidence is missing or of another type is declined as evidence insufficient."

**6. Effect of a grant.** The first extension moves the case to its extension period, and every extension sets the resolution deadline to the extended deadline.

> *Retired wording, no longer in force:* "when the appraisal is older than the plan's appraisal validity months, a new appraisal is ordered, per the plan's reappraisal-for-extension setting".

All retired passages above have been superseded by the current basis.

## Timing of the request, both sides (hypothetical dates)

| Current resolution deadline | Request received | Under item 3 |
|---|---|---|
| 30 June | 15 June | in time, and at the requested lead |
| 30 June | 30 June | in time (the deadline day counts) |
| 30 June | 1 July | declined, received after the deadline |

superseded_clauses: An extension adds extension_days calendar days to the current resolution_deadline and is granted only to a borrower or confirmed successor whose declared intent is sell_property or retain_property and who is actively marketing the property or obtaining financing.

An extension is granted only after HUD's extension_approved step for that extension number is recorded on the case, per extension_hud_approval_required; on a Summit loan Cedarline approves it directly.

No case receives more than max_extensions extensions, counted by maturity_msr_extensions_granted; a request beyond the limit is declined with reason extension_limit_reached, and a request whose evidence is missing or of another type is declined with reason evidence_insufficient.
when the appraisal is older than appraisal_valid_months, a new appraisal is ordered, per reappraisal_for_extension
